title: 8/30 review deferrals: unconfirmed send attempts scored as commits (no delivery_unknown); cached feeds unvalidated and non-atomic; no cutoff inside the DM transport
tier_reason: unfixed residuals of the 8/30 late-pick incident on the delivery and scoring path (a post-cutoff send, a scored pick whose delivery is unknown, a corrupt cached feed); B -> A

contract.text: No pick send lands at or after its cutoff (earliest slot first pitch - 5, picks.SUBMISSION_CUTOFF_MIN); a send whose outcome is unknown is not scored as a delivered commit; cached MLB feed files used by the pipeline are complete.

mechanism.text: after an uncaught crash between send and record, the restart finds delivery_attempted and locks the day as locked_unconfirmed, a scoreable commit: the day is polled and graded as delivered although delivery (and entry) are unknown
download_game_feed returns any existing feed file without validation and writes new ones with write_bytes (no temp file + rename), so a truncated feed would persist in the cache

_deliver_and_lock_pick re-checks the cutoff immediately before calling send_dm, but send_dm makes four sequential HTTP calls (session, handle, conversation, sendMessage) with 15 s timeouts and no overall deadline, so a send that starts just before the cutoff can land after it

watchdog.recovery_assertion: every scored commit has a confirmed pre-cutoff receipt, or is recorded as delivery_unknown and excluded from scoring
